objects.name: railing
adjectives: at the end of the pier

1.action: A person stands at the far end of the pier and shades their eyes with one hand to look out over the sea.

extras.background: Calm blue-gray sea under a pale cream sky with one small cloud, and no visible horizon line beyond the water's edge.

drawingErrors.note: The right edge of the water ends in a sharp vertical edge, and a cream strip runs down the right side. This looks like a cut-off panel and breaks the continuity of the sea.

2.action: The young man stands on the edge of the raised pier with hands in his pockets and looks up and to the right at the sky; he does not interact with anything else.

extras.background: plain cream sky with a small pale blue cloud and a block of blue sea at the bottom right behind the pier posts

drawingErrors.note: The sea is drawn as a flat blue rectangular block with a hard straight top edge and vertical right edge, so it looks pasted on and does not read as water meeting a horizon.

3.action: A man stands at the start of a pier, seen from behind, looking out along it toward the sea; he does not touch anything.

extras.background: Calm blue sea under a pale cream sky with one small cloud, seen past the end of the pier

4.action: A single person stands at the far right end of the pier and looks out over the sea. They don't interact with anything else.

extras.background: Blue sea fills most of the frame. A pale cream strip, probably sand or empty space, runs down the right edge.

5.action: The person leans their folded arms on a wooden railing, rests their chin on one hand, and gazes to the right toward the sea.

extras.background: flat blue sea under a plain cream sky

6.action: A man walks away from the camera along the wooden pier toward its far end, with the sea on both sides of him.

extras.background: calm blue sea under a pale cream sky with one small cloud; the sea ends in a sharp straight edge on the right side

drawingErrors.note: The sea has a hard, straight, vertical right edge that ends abruptly against the pale sky and cream background. It looks like a flat panel and does not blend into a horizon or shoreline.

The pier's perspective is inconsistent. The planks and posts converge toward a vanishing point, but the far end of the pier stops abruptly in the middle of the sea, and its right-side posts do not line up with the sea's edge.

7.action: The man stands at the end of the pier and leans on the railing, looking down at the sea.

extras.background: plain cream sky with a blue sea that ends in a sharp edge on the right side

drawingErrors.note: The water ends in a hard, straight edge on the right and top, like a flat blue panel. It does not look like open sea meeting a horizon.
The left end of the pier is cut by the picture edge. The posts on the right sit at slightly inconsistent angles to the deck.

8.action: A young man walks along the pier toward the viewer with his hands in his pockets, looking off to the side at the sea, and he touches nothing else.

extras.background: A calm blue sea on both sides of the pier under a pale cream sky with one small cloud

drawingErrors.note: On the right side the water ends in a hard vertical edge, like a cliff or pasted block, instead of continuing to a horizon line. It doesn't match the left side, which has a normal horizon.

9.action: A man stands at the end of a wooden pier with his arms crossed, looking up and out over the sea, not touching anything but the pier under his feet.

extras.background: calm sea with a distant green shoreline under a pale cream sky with one small cloud

drawingErrors.note: The right edge of the sea ends in a hard, straight vertical edge with a darker blue strip, so the water looks like a flat panel and breaks the horizon and the edge of the scene.
